name: Think Voice
description: A framework-independent toolkit that connects AI to application actions through repository-owned TypeScript capabilities, workflows, and input/output contracts. A Gemini-powered CLI helps developers integrate it into their codebase.

details.text: The CLI inspects developer-selected source files, proposes changes, and applies them through reviewed diffs, schema validation, and stale-file checks.
The TypeScript Compiler API parses declarative definitions without executing project code, validates dependency graphs, detects cycles, and checks workflow inputs against action schemas.
Inspect workflows, action bindings, schemas, and source definitions with live file refresh and dry-run previews of exact execution inputs.

details.lead: Execution tested in a CRM sandbox.
details.text: Confirmed multi-step actions exercise tenant-scoped permissions, optimistic concurrency, idempotent writes, partial-failure recovery, and reconciliation when responses are lost after successful commits.

name: Prism
summary: From a rough idea to a build-ready plan.
description: An AI workspace that refines requirements through conversation, extracts design tokens from references, and generates four UI mockups with engineering task breakdowns.

details.text: Task-specific model routing with automatic failover and prompt-cache optimization. Vision-based design extraction connects visual references to UI generation. Frontend and backend task plans export to Excel.

name: Document Intelligence
summary: Ask better questions of complex documents.
description: A retrieval-grounded assistant that turns PDFs into searchable knowledge, with answers and comparisons across organizations and reporting years.

details.text: A document pipeline handles PDF parsing, chunking, embeddings, and indexing. Retrieval supplies relevant context for grounded answers and cross-organization, year-over-year comparisons.

detailNote: Built with Next.js, LangChain, Qdrant, and Valkey.
